findings.title: Every tool card shows the same wrench placeholder instead of the tool
findings.description: All ten cards on find use an identical wrench glyph in a pale square as the thumbnail. The slot promises a picture of the tool but carries no information, so cards look like a template with placeholders left in.
findings.impact: Members are likely to have to read every title to tell a drill from a ladder, and the page reads as unfinished; the one area where this product's real stock could give it character is blank.
findings.recommendation: Decide what the thumbnail slot should carry for this library (its own photographs of the actual items, or a drawn device that differs per category), or remove the slot.

findings.title: No brand layer or signature on any surface
findings.description: Across find, tool, basket, confirm and done the identity-carrying elements (type voice, colour use, masthead, imagery) are the public-service-form default; the name sits in bold body text beside a stock wrench glyph. Nothing from the library's own world appears visually.
findings.impact: The 'neighbourly' attribute is carried by copy only, and the reservation may feel like an anonymous council form rather than the volunteer desk members know.
findings.recommendation: Decide one element from the library's own world (for example something taken from the membership card the colour already references) to carry 'neighbourly' visually, within the Operate budget: masthead, done page or the session calendar.

findings.title: Sticky reserve bar covers the calendar and overhangs the content column
findings.description: On tool, the white action bar sits over the calendar rows and over the 'Choose the day…' instructions in the captures; at 1280 its button extends to x=1264, past the 1184 px content edge everything else aligns to.
findings.impact: The page's main decision (the pick-up day) may be hidden behind its own action, and the misaligned button looks unfinished.

evidence.detail: corroborated after unseal by A11Y-05 and FUN-06 #reserve hits

findings.recommendation: Decide how the bar and the page content share space (reserved space at the end of the page, alignment to the content column).

findings.title: Tool spec list split into two misaligned label columns
findings.description: On tool, 'Category / Deposit / Available from' use one label width and 'Chuck / Batteries / Weight / Case' directly below use a narrower one, so values start at two different x positions (224 px vs 180 px at 1280).
findings.impact: The details look assembled from two sources and scanning values down the column is harder; it undercuts 'careful'.
findings.recommendation: Treat the details as one list with one label column.

findings.title: Basket session cards: reverse order and a one-plus-five layout at desktop
findings.description: Sessions run from Wednesday 28 October down to Saturday 10 October; at 1280 the first is full width and the other five are squeezed into a row where each label wraps to three lines.
findings.impact: The full-width first card implies it is recommended or different when it is just the latest date; members choosing 'Saturday morning' may have to read all six; the wraps look unfinished.
findings.recommendation: Decide one order and one layout for the session list in which all sessions have equal weight and the chosen pick-up day is easy to find.

findings.title: Find page on phones: titles truncated, search below all cards, nav labels wrapped
findings.description: At 375 and 320 card titles cut off with an ellipsis ('Cordless drill 18 V, co…'), so the two drills are indistinguishable; the search field moves below all ten cards; nav items wrap to two lines ('Find a / tool').
findings.impact: On the main device, members may not tell 'two batteries' from 'one battery', a distinction their own words use, and may not find search at all.
findings.recommendation: Decide the phone layout from the members' task: full tool names visible, search reachable at the top, nav that fits.

findings.title: Empty bands and half-used columns on basket, confirm and done at wide widths
findings.description: At 1280, basket and done end with the footer well above the viewport bottom and a flat grey band below; confirm fields and the done 'What happens next' box take the left half of the column with the right half empty.
findings.impact: The pages look unfinished on desktop lunch-break use, and the done page gives no sense of a completed reservation.
findings.recommendation: Decide the page frame for short pages (footer anchoring, column use) and what the done page shows to mark the reservation.

findings.title: Masthead still shows 'Basket (1)' after the reservation is confirmed
findings.description: On done, the nav reads 'Basket (1)' although the reservation FT-4471 has been made.
findings.impact: Members may think the tool is still waiting in the basket and the reservation did not go through.
findings.recommendation: Make the basket count reflect the state after confirmation.

findings.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px
findings.description: The 320 capture is 346 px wide; tool cards reach the right edge with no margin.
findings.impact: Members using larger text or small phones are likely to scroll sideways and lose the right edge of every card.
findings.recommendation: Make the card layout fit 320 px.

_strengths: Copy in the volunteer's voice with concrete detail ('Enough for a day of fixing shelves and a fence', 'Nothing is paid online. Bring the deposit and your membership card').
Composed dark theme: cards lighter than the ground, lightened greens, same roles.
Deposit and availability on every card; one filled action per page.
_keep: Keep the plain, concrete volunteer voice and the one-action-per-page discipline.
